title: NICE Technology Appraisal and Highly Specialised Technologies Guidance: The Manual
source_rights_note: The source PDF is not bundled. This profile contains short method paraphrases and source locators only.
scope: Economic-evaluation reference-case subset for NICE technology appraisal and highly specialised technologies in England.
limitations: This profile is an executable subset, not a reproduction of PMG36.
A complete matrix is a prerequisite for local review and is not a claim of NICE acceptance or legal compliance.

Cost-comparison, paediatric HRQoL, diagnostics, equality weighting, severity modifiers, managed access, and topic-specific scope decisions still require direct review of the current manual and topic scope.

requirements.title: Define the technologies, population, perspective, outcomes, jurisdiction, and horizon for the NICE decision problem
Use this profile only for an England decision context
requirements.source_locator: PMG36 scope and Sections 4.2.7-4.2.10, PDF pages 5-7 and 64-65

requirements.title: Use and justify comparator strategies consistent with the NICE topic scope
Use NHS and personal social services as the reference-case cost perspective
Use a horizon long enough to capture all important cost and outcome differences
Use QALYs for a cost-utility reference-case analysis
Present a fully incremental analysis of the compared technologies
requirements.source_locator: Table 4.1 and Section 4.10.8, PDF pages 62-63 and 95
